title: Letter Case Variations
summary: Return every string formed by independently toggling each letter's case.
statement: Return every string formed by independently toggling each letter's case. Implement `letter_case_variations` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: Letters branch into lower and upper choices while nonletters have one branch.
Advance one position per recursive call and append at the text-length base case.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the letter_case_variations invariant is complete.
Editorial: Advance one position per recursive call and append at the text-length base case. The intended bounds are O(2ˡ) time and O(n) space.
editorial: Letters branch into lower and upper choices while nonletters have one branch. Advance one position per recursive call and append at the text-length base case. This yields O(2ˡ) time and O(n) auxiliary space.
